entries.name: Complete-city tile and public-transport demo databases derived from OpenStreetMap
entries.license: ODbL 1.0
entries.source: OpenStreetMap contributors — BBBike Minsk city extract (Geofabrik Belarus extract as documented fallback)
entries.modificationNote: Projected to UTM zone 35N, tiled at 1024 m, building volumes de-overlapped, heights and roof shapes inferred or curated, facades and road surfaces derived procedurally, trees inferred/placed. The mobility payload adds a directed street/rail network, stop projections and a procedural demo timetable. Both adapted databases are published under ODbL 1.0 with their notice in data/LICENSE-ODbL.txt.
